subject.title: fix(apple-container): guard Cleanup orphan sweep against a concurrent Acquire's claim

question: Should the deterministic base-fails/head-passes race reproduction, supplemented by the real Apple Container lifecycle run, satisfy the proof requirement for this timing-only cleanup fix?
rationale: The exact sub-200ms interleaving is not naturally reachable through two ordinary CLI processes, while the real transcript does not execute the changed path; accepting this proof standard or overriding it requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Apply proof override
options.body: Accept the deterministic interleaving tests and real-runtime lifecycle transcript as sufficient for this timing-only race, then proceed with ordinary merge review.

options.title: Require instrumented live proof
options.body: Keep the proof gate until a real Apple runtime run deliberately injects or rebinds a claim during the cleanup snapshot window and records its survival.
